description: Targeted language review of the recorded consecutive entries. Reviews focus on erroneous Korean glosses, headword/example mismatches, unnatural Japanese, and repetitive examples; reviewed coverage does not imply exhaustive linguistic certification of every sentence.

changes.word: デモンストレーション

notes: 悪日 has the rare reading あくび (also あくにち). The source reading is retained.
Regenerate word-furigana output after integrating revised examples into main.
一定 (entry 131): corrected headword reading from archaic いちじょう to modern いってい to match both examples and breakdown.
火傷 (entry 446): corrected headword reading from technical かしょう to everyday やけど to match example readings.
501~1000: manually checked every word against its reading, Korean gloss and both examples; corrected inaccurate meanings and unnatural examples.
強気（ごうぎ） is a rare/older reading, different from modern 強気（つよき）. Explicit furigana added in the example.
1001~1500: manually checked 500 word meanings and two examples per word; corrected mistranslations, false readings in examples, and repetitive examples.
Preserved rare headword readings 地方（じかた）, 盛る（さかる）, 丈夫（じょうふ） and 心中（しんじゅう）; adjusted examples to match.
Second examples for 産婦人科 and 萎びる are in bank 30; coverage was verified.
1501~2000: checked meanings, readings, Korean glosses and both example sentences for all 500 words; corrected nonsensical translations, example mismatches, and duplicate contexts.
中腹: corrected reading to ちゅうふく for mountainside; dictionary also documents the different obsolete ちゅうっぱら sense. Preserved verified rare readings 梯子（ていし） and 鉄片（てっぺん）.
2001~2500: checked all 500 N1 lexical entries with Korean glosses, readings, and both Japanese/Korean examples. Fixed mistranslations, source headword mismatch and unnatural examples.
Normalized uncommon 何々（どれどれ） display to どれどれ and uncommon 悪い（にくい） display to 憎い; retained stable IDs. Aligned 鼠（ねず） examples to traditional gray-color use and 南（なん） examples to on-yomi compounds.
2501~2933: manually checked remaining 433 N1 words and both examples, corrected translations, example reading/word mismatches and overly repetitive contexts.
Normalized 目覚ましい headword and aligned 夜中（よなか） and 奴（やつ） with natural modern readings and both example sentences.
